info.name: Flexpress delivery-service
info.description:
Local testing against `docker compose up` + `npm run start:dev`. No environment needed.

1. Run the **Auth** folder first (stores tokens as collection variables).
2. Run **Orders** in order (A1 stores `orderId`), or use Run collection.

request.description: Dev-only password grant. Stores the access token in `tokenDispatcherA`. Tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Dev-only password grant. Stores the access token in `tokenDriverA`. Tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Dev-only password grant. Stores the access token in `tokenDispatcherB`. Tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Dev-only password grant. Stores the access token in `tokenDriverB`. Tokens expire after 15 minutes.
Stores the new id in `orderId` for the following requests.

item.name: A3. Create order with companyId in body → 400

request.description: companyId always comes from the token; the ValidationPipe rejects unknown fields.

item.name: A4. Create order with blank address → 400
B1. List orders (dispatcher A) → 200, contains new order
B2. List orders (dispatcher B) → 200, no company A orders

exec: pm.test('no orders of company A', () => pm.expect(r.items.filter(i => i.companyId === pm.variables.get('companyA'))).to.have.length(0));

item.name: B3. List orders filtered by status and date → 200
B5. List orders with from after to → 400
B6. List orders (driver A) → 200, only own orders

exec: pm.test('only orders assigned to driver A', () => pm.response.json().items.forEach(i => pm.expect(i.assignedDriverId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('driverAId'))));

item.name: C2. Get company A order as dispatcher B → 404

request.description: Cross-company access is 404, not 403, so the order's existence is not revealed.

item.name: C3. Get unassigned order as driver A → 404
C4. Get order with non-UUID id → 400
C5. Get order with invalid token → 401

exec: // Build a deliberately broken bearer token at runtime (valid token + extra characters).

request.description: A tampered token (signature no longer matches) must be rejected with 401.

item.name: W2. Assign to driver A (dispatcher A) → 200

exec: pm.test('ASSIGNED to driver A', () => { const o = pm.response.json(); pm.expect(o.status).to.eql('ASSIGNED'); pm.expect(o.assignedDriverId).to.eql(pm.variables.get('driverAId')); });

item.name: W5. PICKED_UP with GPS (driver A, new key) → 200

request.description: Pre-request script generates a fresh Idempotency-Key and stores it in `idemKey`.

item.name: W6. Retry W5 with the same key → 200 replayed

request.description: Same key and body as W5: returns the stored response, no second change or event.

item.name: W8. Driver B on driver A's order → 404
W9. Skip a step PICKED_UP → DELIVERED → 409
W15. Upload photo with wrong Content-Type → 403

request.description: Content-Type is part of the signature, so storage rejects other types.

item.name: W16. Upload photo to presigned URL → 200

request.description: Direct upload to MinIO/S3 (no API token). In a real client, send the image file as the body.

exec: pm.test('one event per change, retry not duplicated', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().map(e => e.toStatus)).to.eql(['ASSIGNED', 'PICKED_UP', 'IN_TRANSIT', 'DELIVERED']));

item.name: W20. Status history as dispatcher B → 404
